episodes.title: Ep 1: Warning Signs
episodes.description: A promising first date. Troubling stories of an estranged wife. Then, silence. Nancy Jo Hancock recalls her evening with Charles Vallow – and a discovery months later that cast their date in a different light. Months later, in eastern Idaho, journalist Nate Eaton follows a strange missing-children case and begins uncovering a troubling web of deaths, disappearances, and extreme beliefs. episodes.description: What started as a search for two missing children exposed a chilling story of murder, spiritual manipulation and fractured families.
